nchsNatality: read and losslessly pack NCHS natality public-use files

Source: R/nchsNatality-package.R
nchsNatality-package.Rd

The NCHS natality public-use file is fixed width: one record per birth, no delimiters and no quoting. That defeats delimiter-sniffing readers such as data.table::fread(). This package reads the file by byte position, using a record layout and value labels extracted from the NCHS User Guide.

Details

Main functions:

  • check_natality_file() reports line endings and record length.

  • diagnose_layout() checks that the documented layout fits the file.

  • read_natality() reads fields into a data.table, typed or raw.

  • label_natality() turns categorical codes into labelled factors.

  • natality_pack() writes compact, sharded Parquet that is checked to be lossless; natality_verify() and natality_unpack() go with it.

  • natality_layout() and natality_values() return the layout and the value labels.

Layout source

"User Guide to the 2025 Natality Public Use File" (NCHS), record layout. data-raw/parse_userguide.py in the source package regenerates the tables and lists the corrections made to errors in the guide.
